title: The Strong Law of Large Numbers for random semigroups with unbounded generators on uniformly smooth Banach spaces
comment: 7 pages, no figures; minor revision, \S4 `Discussion and conclusion' added
abstract: We consider random linear unbounded operators on a Banach space $\mathcal{X}$. For example, such random operators may be random quantum channels. The Law of Large Numbers is known when $\mathcal{X}$ is a Hilbert space, in the form of the usual Law of Large Numbers for random operators, and in some other particular cases. Instead of the sum of i.i.d. variables, there may be considered the composition of random semigroups $e^{A_i t/n}$. We obtain the Strong Law of Large Numbers in Strong Operator Topology for random semigroups of unbounded linear operators on a uniformly smooth Banach space.
